title: Valorization of Hom Thong Banana Peel (Musa sp., AAA Group) as an Anti-Melanogenic Agent Through Inhibition of Pigmentary Genes and Molecular Docking Study.
authors: Linsaenkart, Pichchapa; Yooin, Wipawadee; Jiranusornkul, Supat; Sringarm, Korawan; Arjin, Chaiwat; Rachtanapun, Pornchai; Jantanasakulwong, Kittisak; Castagnini, Juan M; Ruksiriwanich, Warintorn
one_liner_zh: 该文研究香蕉皮提取物抑制黑色素生成，分子对接对象为酪氨酸酶而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Prolonged and unprotected exposure to the environment explicitly influences the development of hyperpigmented lesions. The enzyme tyrosinase (TYR) is a key target for regulating melanin synthesis. Several bioactive compounds derived from plant extracts have been found to possess potent anti-melanogenesis properties against TYR. In particular, the potential of banana peels from various varieties has garnered interest due to their application in skin hyperpigmentation treatment. A molecular docking study demonstrated interactions between rosmarinic acid, which is predominantly found in all Hom Thong peel extracts, and the active site of TYR (PDB ID: 2Y9X) at residues HIS263, VAL283, SER282, and MET280, with the lowest binding energy of -5.05 kcal/mol, showing the strongest interaction. Additionally, Hom Thong banana peels are rich in phenolic compounds that could inhibit melanin content and tyrosinase activity in both human and mouse melanoma cells. These effects may be attributed to the suppression of gene expression related to melanogenesis, including the regulator gene MITF and pigmentary genes TYR, TRP-1, and DCT, indicating effects comparable to those of the standard treatment groups with arbutin and kojic acid. Our findings indicated the potential of Hom Thong peel extracts as anti-melanogenic agents.
abstract_zh: 长期且未加防护的环境暴露显著影响色素沉着性病变的发展。酪氨酸酶（TYR）是调控黑色素合成的关键靶点。已发现多种源自植物提取物的生物活性化合物对TYR具有强效的抗黑色素生成特性。特别是，不同品种香蕉皮在皮肤色素沉着治疗中的应用潜力引起了关注。分子对接研究显示，在所有Hom Thong果皮提取物中主要存在的迷迭香酸，与TYR（PDB ID: 2Y9X）活性位点的残基HIS263、VAL283、SER282和MET280发生相互作用，其最低结合能为-5.05 kcal/mol，表现出最强的相互作用。此外，Hom Thong香蕉皮富含酚类化合物，可抑制人和小鼠黑色素瘤细胞中的黑色素含量及酪氨酸酶活性。这些效应可能归因于对黑色素生成相关基因表达的抑制，包括调节基因MITF和色素基因TYR、TRP-1及DCT，表明其效果与标准治疗组中的熊果苷和曲酸相当。我们的研究结果表明，Hom Thong果皮提取物具有作为抗黑色素生成剂的潜力。
